items.name: AI Agent Marketplace & Builder Platform
items.summary: A platform where creators build, publish, and monetize specialized AI agents (coding, research, sales, ops) that users can discover, test in a sandbox, and deploy with one click — priced per run or subscription.
items.why_now: Explosion of Product Hunt launches (Kopai, Ninjō, BetterClaw, Tycoon, Pancake, CartAI, CustomAgent, Agensi, AiPayGen, indie.money, AgentHub, AgentMarketplace — 12+ in 2026). Upwork: AI agent development demand doubled YoY. Chrome: AI sidebar extensions growing 127.5% in 22 days (ChatGPT in Sidebar). n8n: 80% of 1.7M builders' workflows now involve AI agents. Reddit analysis of 9,300+ "wish there was" posts shows strong unmet demand for agent marketplaces.
items.monetization: Marketplace take-rate 20-30% (CustomAgent 80% to creators, Kopai 70%, AgentMarketplace ~20%, indie.money 10% cash-out). Additional: subscription tiers for buyers ($49-499/mo), white-label marketplace licenses ($499-4,999/mo), per-execution fees. CustomAgent reports $4,200/mo avg creator revenue.

items.name: AI search visibility / GEO brand-citation checker
items.summary: A free web tool that checks how often a brand or competitor is named (and where) inside answers from ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Claude, then generates an llms.txt/citation audit with fixes.
items.why_now: AI answer engines handle an estimated 28% of online search and 'Answer Engine Optimization' search interest is ~99x i.e. exploding; 54% of marketing teams plan GEO but only ~23% measure it, so the demand is huge right now.
items.monetization: Enterprise GEO platforms sell ACVs of $48k-$285k; Peec AI claims 3,000+ customers and Otterly AI 10,000+ users; this free audit becomes the funnel for a $29-$212/mo monitoring product.

items.name: PDF/Document Parsing & Data Extraction API
items.summary: AI-powered API that extracts structured data (tables, line items, fields) from PDFs, scans, and photos — invoices, bank statements, receipts, contracts — without templates, returning clean JSON/CSV/Excel.
items.why_now: Parseur: $1.2M ARR, 60% YoY growth (PRNewswire, LinkedIn). InvoiceAI: $283K verified all-time revenue (TrustMRR). Extraly, FlowParse, Sensible, Ordalis, Papersnap all live with pricing $5-200/mo. "pdf to markdown" 2,900/mo searches (BuildThis). Invoice automation market $2.78B→$9.18B at 14.2% CAGR (Gennai). 75% AP departments use some automation but only 8% fully automated (Medius/Parseur). E-invoicing mandates expanding (Belgium 1M+ Peppol recipients).
items.monetization: Per-page pricing ($5-20/mo for 200-2,000 pages), API volume plans, enterprise contracts. Parseur charges per page; Extraly $5-20/mo tiered; FlowParse per-page with validation free. High retention: document processing is sticky infrastructure.

items.name: LLM model router / cost-optimization calculator
items.summary: A free website comparing 400+ LLMs live by price per token, latency and quality, telling users which model to route each task to and what it would cost.
items.why_now: AI model routing became core infrastructure: OpenRouter went from ~$19M to ~$160M annualized revenue in 8 months (reported Stripe acquisition ~$7.5B), and a beginner product 'LLM Gateway' hit +260% MoM to $57k MRR; indies and enterprises all need cost-per-task decisions.
items.monetization: Take-rate/affiliate on inference spend (OpenRouter's model is a ~5% fee; ~$2.5B in routed spend crossed its platform), plus enterprise tiers.

items.name: Medical-bill audit & dispute web tool
items.summary: Upload an itemized hospital or physician bill; it flags duplicate, mis-coded and inflated line items against published price benchmarks and auto-drafts dispute and financial-assistance letters. A free, no-signup web version of what physician-led negotiation startups now sell.
items.why_now: Fresh entrants and rules landed in the last weeks: Clearity Health launched a physician-led negotiation service on 2026-09-28 (20% of savings, capped at $1,000); calliora raised $6M pre-seed on 2026-10-06; CMS began enforcing expanded 2026 hospital price-transparency data on 2026-04-01. The negotiation/payment-plan service market is $2.31B in 2026 heading to $4.28B by 2034 (8.2% CAGR), with CFPB citing ~$88B of medical bills in collections.
items.monetization: Peers charge a share of savings (Clearity: 20% capped at $1,000), flat per-bill fees (mediloop $129 per bill, $499/yr for up to 6 bills), or one-time audits around $99. A free audit tool monetizes via upsell to human negotiation, lead-gen/affiliate, or premium letter packets.

items.name: Short-Form Video Intelligence & Analytics
items.summary: Real-time analytics platform for TikTok, Reels, Shorts that tracks viral trends, competitor performance, outlier detection, and content gaps — turning signals into scripts, briefs, and ad creative.
items.why_now: Virlo: 62,115 users, 3,261 paying, $31K MRR at 35% MoM growth (Indie Hackers, PressRelease). Reelyze: $626/mo verified (TrustMRR), launched June 2026. Kurrently: MCP-compatible AI research agent for trends. Edge browser: Entertainment installs +323.7% YoY (Exstats). YouTube Shorts monetization maturing. Cross-platform benchmarking demand rising.
items.monetization: SaaS subscriptions: Virlo $49-199/mo (credits-based), Reelyze $19-149/mo, Kurrently $15-250/mo. API access for agencies/developers. Virlo reports 1,700+ teams on platform. High expansion revenue via team seats and credit overages.

items.name: AI Video Generation & Editing for Short-Form
items.summary: Tools that generate or edit short-form videos (Reels, TikToks, Shorts) from text, audio, or long-form source — auto-clipping, captioning, reframing, hook detection, and multi-platform publishing.
items.why_now: Upwork: AI video generation/editing +329% YoY (fastest-growing skill). Fiverr: AI UGC video ads +265%. Mootion: $100-150K MRR from AppSumo launch (AppSumo Blog). Market research: $1.2B→$16.8B at 37% CAGR (Research Intelo). Video-to-shorts = 48.5% of repurposing revenue. Dozens of competitors (OpusClip, Munch, VFX AI, Hyperclip, Taskade Genesis, Repurpose.io, LumiClip, Inflio, Ssemble).
items.monetization: Freemium SaaS: $15-220/mo (OpusClip $15-29, Munch $49-220, Taskade $10-250, Repurpose.io $35-179). Credit-based for render minutes. Enterprise white-label. High NRR reported (>110% industry-wide per Research Intelo).
how_searched: Freelance market data (Upwork, Fiverr, Uphunt, Catalora)

items.name: Free meeting transcription & AI meeting notes
items.summary: A free web tool that records or ingests meetings, transcribes them, and produces summaries, action items and searchable notes without a meeting bot.
items.why_now: Transcription/meeting-notes was the fastest-growing AI site category July→August 2026 (+35.3% MoM), with hinoter.com +2,416% to ~2.48M visits and iamtypist.dev +771% to ~6.61M; OpenAI launched a Meetings plugin beta at DevDay (Sept 29, 2026); Circleback opened unlimited transcription for free on Aug 31, 2026, cutting its paid plan from ~$21 to $15/mo.
items.monetization: Circleback claims ~$8M annual revenue with just 8 employees while replacing ads with a free tier; Plaud (device + subscription) debuted at #16 on the a16z consumer-spend list — so freemium tiers plus team seats are proven.
how_searched: traffic-estimator study via dev.to (2,916 AI-site crawl)
consumer AI app index (a16z Top 100, 7th edition)

items.name: Self-Hosted Workflow Automation for AI Agents (n8n-style)
items.summary: Fair-code / open-source workflow automation platform that technical teams self-host for free (unlimited executions) to build AI agent pipelines, RAG, and multi-step automations — with paid cloud/enterprise for governance, SSO, and managed infrastructure.
items.why_now: n8n: $40M ARR (Oct 2025), $5.2B valuation (May 2026 SAP), 1.7M monthly active builders, 10x revenue growth 2025, 10,000+ community templates, 80% workflows involve AI agents (Sacra, OKARA, ValueAddVC). Zapier: $300M+ projected 2026. Upwork: AI integration +178% YoY. Chrome: Productivity/tools extensions +30.8% Q2 2026 (Exstats). Activepieces (MIT-licensed) rising as alternative.
items.monetization: Cloud subscriptions (n8n: €20-800/mo execution-based), paid self-hosted licenses (Business/Enterprise for SSO, Git ops, audit), OEM/embed deals (SAP Joule Studio). Template marketplace commissions. Freelancers earn $800-2,500/project + $99-149/mo retainers (AFFStudio). Micro-SaaS built on n8n: $49-299/mo per user.

items.name: Buyer-intent finder for Reddit / X / HN
items.summary: A free tool that scans Reddit, X and Hacker News for posts where people are actively asking for a solution ('am I looking for a tool that...', 'mailchimp alternative'), scores buying intent and shows the best threads in a ranked digest.
items.why_now: After GummySearch/Howitzer shut down in late 2025, a wave of small replacements (MentionLeads, Buska, ReplyGain, Heardley, IntentAlert, Leadly) launched, and Buska's study of 451,903 posts found Reddit supplies ~77% of high-intent buying signals; founders on r/ycombinator explicitly say they'd pay $100/mo for this.
items.monetization: Established pricing is $9-$249/mo; MentionLeads $19-$59/mo, Buska $49-$249/mo, Heardley $9/mo or $54 lifetime; the free tier does UGC discovery, paid tiers automate scoring/slack/CRM.
how_searched: competitor product marketing pages with public pricing

items.name: AI SDR & Autonomous Sales Agents
items.summary: AI agents that engage website visitors in real time, qualify leads, give personalized demos, handle objections, and book meetings — integrating with CRM and sales stacks for 24/7 pipeline generation.
items.why_now: Product Hunt: Clara AI SDR, Ninjō AI ($750K generated for clients, 200+ booked calls/mo), Pancake (autonomous GTM agents), CartAI (checkout agent). Upwork: AI chatbot development +71% YoY. Fiverr: dedicated AI agent category. Ninjō reports insurance broker agent quoting 6 carriers live in chat. Pancake runs 23 autonomous agents doing 3 tasks/day each.
items.monetization: SaaS subscriptions per seat/agent (Clara, Ninjō), per-conversation pricing (AgentHub), revenue share on agent marketplace (Kopai 70% to creator). Ninjō: free tier 1,000 msgs, paid plans for scale. High value per customer: $200K+ generated per client reported.
how_searched: Freelance market reports (Upwork, Fiverr via Memvers/Uphunt)
Customer case studies in launch posts

items.name: Prompt-injection & AI-guardrail red-team scanner
items.summary: Free web tool where builders paste a system prompt, agent definition or RAG config and instantly get a scored report of prompt-injection, data-exfiltration and jailbreak failures, plus a reusable test suite that can be re-run on every model change. It is the open/free version of what enterprise vendors now sell as continuous agent red-teaming.
items.why_now: Search interest for 'AI Guardrails' is up 8,400% on Exploding Topics; commercial tool BenchBot claims most AI applications fail at least 30% of its injection tests; and the EU AI Act's Article 50 transparency duties have been enforceable since 02 Aug 2026, making basic guardrail testing a compliance-driven habit rather than a nice-to-have.
items.monetization: Free scans in the browser, paid seats for CI/API re-runs, team dashboards and compliance-ready exportable reports — the same packaging BenchBot/Nforcer use with enterprise buyers.
items.how_searched: Searched trending AI-security and compliance terms on Exploding Topics and Google Trends, then opened the EU AI Act implementation timeline and a commercial prompt-injection testing vendor to verify live demand.

items.name: Text or image to 3D model generator
items.summary: A free web tool that turns a text prompt or a photo into a downloadable 3D model (glTF/STL) for games, printing and product mockups.
items.why_now: 3D modeling grew +34.6% MoM across 2,916 tracked AI sites (July→Aug 2026), hi3d.ai hit ~2.72M visits (+55%), open-source text-to-CAD repos are scaling fast (earthtojake/text-to-cad 18,301 stars, pushed Oct 8, 2026; Adam-CAD/CADAM 5,218 stars), and Meshy.ai reached 18.1M monthly visits (+97.8% MoM) per AlphaMoat's April 2026 report.
items.monetization: Revenue not verified (null); the category's standard model is per-generation credits/subscriptions — Meshy's 18.1M-visit scale and paid CAD tools (Backflip, $30M raised) show willingness to pay.
how_searched: GitHub API + repository pages (star counts, last push)

items.name: Embeddable AI Agent / Copilot for SaaS
items.summary: Drop-in AI agent (one line of code) that lets end-users control any SaaS via natural language — turning clicks into conversations, with scoped permissions, audit logs, and model-agnostic deployment.
items.why_now: Product Hunt: Yedric.ai (#2 daily, 312 votes) — "Let users control your SaaS with natural language." CustomAgent, AgentHub, AgentMarketplace all offer embeddable agents. Dots by OpenAI (always-on agents in ChatGPT). Rising demand for "AI-native" SaaS without building from scratch. Chrome: AI sidebar extensions (Sider 5M users, Monica 3M) show user appetite for in-app AI.
items.monetization: B2B SaaS: per-seat or per-agent pricing (Yedric: deploy in 30 min), usage-based (AgentHub per-conversation), white-label marketplace (CustomAgent $499-4,999/mo). High expansion: start with 1 agent, add across functions.

items.name: AI music generator
items.summary: A free web tool where anyone types a style and lyrics and gets an original playable, downloadable song in seconds.
items.why_now: Suno hit 2M paid subscribers and $300M ARR (Feb 2026) and raised $400M at a $5.4B valuation (June 2026); 'AI Music Generator' search growth is +5,200% in Exploding Topics' Oct 6, 2026 list; flowmusic.app grew +105% MoM to ~6.19M visits.
items.monetization: Subscriptions: Suno's 2M payers generate $300M ARR; MBW reports 100M total users — free tier for discovery, paid tiers for downloads/commercial rights.
how_searched: traffic study via dev.to (audio/music category +19% MoM)

items.name: Browser Extension AI Productivity Tools
items.summary: Chrome/Firefox/Edge extensions that bring AI into the browser — sidebar chat, page summarization, writing assistance, workflow automation, content extraction — with freemium subscriptions.
items.why_now: Chrome Web Store: 221,717 extensions, +43,418 net in Q2 2026 (Exstats). AI = 17% of new Chrome extensions. Monica: 3M users, 4.89★. Sider: 5M users, 4.92★. ChatGPT in Sidebar: +127.5% in 22 days (zPlatform). Firefox: 95 AI add-ons, 906K combined daily users. Productivity/tools = fastest-growing Chrome category (+30.8%). RightTail: extensions with 100K+ users earn $10K-50K+/mo.
items.monetization: Freemium: $2.99-9.99/mo or $19.99-49.99/yr. Conversion 1-5%. 100K+ users → $10K-50K+/mo. Affiliate/commission for shopping tools. One-time purchase for dev tools ($9.99, 5% conversion → $75K/yr). Chrome Web Store takes 30% on in-app purchases.

items.name: Background removal & AI product photography
items.summary: A free browser tool that removes image backgrounds and generates clean product photos (and virtual try-on shots) for listings and ads.
items.why_now: 'Background Removal' is #1 on Rising Trends' retail list at 1,000,000 monthly searches, +641% YoY; Upwork's In-Demand Skills 2026 shows AI image generation & editing demand +95% YoY; Photoroom ranks among the top AI-native apps in the a16z consumer index; 'Try On' also entered the Oct 2026 retail trend list.
items.monetization: Freemium export credits plus per-image packs; Upwork's +95% growth in paid AI image work shows businesses already pay for this output.
how_searched: search-trend database (Rising Trends retail trends, Sept/Oct 2026)
freelance marketplace report (Upwork In-Demand Skills 2026 via Nasdaq PR)

items.name: AI Content Repurposing (Long-Form → Short-Form)
items.summary: Platform that ingests one long-form video/podcast/webinar and automatically outputs dozens of platform-optimized clips, captions, blog posts, newsletters, and social threads — with scheduling and publishing.
items.why_now: Market: $1.2B→$16.8B at 37% CAGR (Research Intelo). Video-to-shorts = 48.5% of revenue. 10+ well-funded competitors (OpusClip, Munch, Repurpose.io, Taskade Genesis, VFX AI, Hyperclip, LumiClip, Inflio, Ssemble, Castmagic, Descript). Taskade Genesis runs full pipeline as cloneable app. Repurpose.io: 10 free videos then $35-179/mo. VFX AI case study: 400+ videos → 47K followers → $127K course sales.
items.monetization: Freemium SaaS: $10-250/mo (Taskade $10-250, OpusClip $15-29, Munch $49-220, Repurpose.io $35-179, Inflio $79-Enterprise). Processing-minute pricing (LumiClip). High NRR (>110%). Agency white-label.

items.name: Interactive demo / product tour builder
items.summary: A free web tool that turns screenshots or a recorded click-through into an embeddable, clickable product tour with hotspots and analytics.
items.why_now: Navattic built 40,000+ demos in a year (+43% YoY), only 18% of ~5,000 B2B sites have one vs 12% in 2024, and AI demo products keep launching (Supademo AI Demo Agent was #7 on Product Hunt Oct 7 2026); the demo-automation category is projected ~$2.1B for 2026.
items.monetization: Category pricing is $38-$575/mo (Arcade $42.50/seat, Supademo $38/creator, Walnut $575/mo) with weak free tiers - a strong free/open version has clear upgrade headroom.

items.name: AI contract-review / plain-English clause explainer
items.summary: Upload a contract and get a plain-English summary, flagged one-sided clauses, missing standard terms and suggested redlines. A free self-serve layer under tools that enterprises pay heavily for.
items.why_now: Multiple independent market reports published Aug-Oct 2026 show rapid growth: generative-AI legal contract drafting/review reaches $4.21B in 2026 to $14.76B by 2031 (28.52% CAGR); AI contract-analysis tools $4.3B in 2026 to $12.06B by 2030 (29.6% CAGR); a separate estimate puts AI contract review at $823M in 2025 to $6.83B by 2034 (26.5% CAGR). Vendors report 60-80% cuts in initial review time, pushing adoption from trials to production.
items.monetization: Freemium: free single-contract explanation, paid bulk review, redline packs, team plans, or API. Enterprise incumbents monetize via per-seat/annual subscriptions and per-agreement pricing; a free consumer tier is an open wedge.

items.name: Invoice & AP Automation (AI-First)
items.summary: End-to-end invoice processing: email/file intake → AI extraction (line items, PO matching) → validation → ERP/accounting sync → approval workflow → payment — with KPI dashboards (cost/invoice, cycle time, touchless rate).
items.why_now: Parseur: $1.2M ARR, 60% YoY. Market: $2.78B→$9.18B at 14.2% CAGR (Gennai). 75% AP depts use automation but only 8% fully automated (Medius). 68% still manually key data (DocuClipper). E-invoicing mandates live across EU/ME (Belgium 1M+ Peppol). Best-in-class cost/invoice $2.78 vs avg $12.88 (78% gap = $60K/yr savings at 500/mo).
items.monetization: Per-page/page-volume pricing (Parseur), per-invoice, or seat-based. Plans from $29/mo (250 invoices) to enterprise. High stickiness: embedded in finance workflows. Expansion via multi-entity, approval chains, payment integration.

items.name: AI ad-creative & UGC generator for marketers
items.summary: A free web tool that turns a product link or brief into ad creatives — static ads, hooks and UGC-style scripts — ready for paid campaigns.
items.why_now: Melius raised $25M ($20M Series A led by CRV, $5M seed led by General Catalyst) announced Oct 6, 2026 to build 'agents for creative work'; 'UGC Creator' search growth is +8,600% in Exploding Topics' Oct 6, 2026 list; Upwork shows AI video generation & editing +329% and display advertising +26% YoY.
items.monetization: Subscription/credit plans for creative teams; the market pays freelancers for exactly this work (Upwork display advertising +26%, AI video gen +329%) and VCs just funded standalone tools (Melius $25M).

items.name: AI phone-receptionist / missed-call recovery web tool
items.summary: A web-based assistant that answers or texts back missed business calls, books appointments and captures leads. The rebuildable free angle is an instant missed-call ROI calculator plus a browser-based answering agent.
items.why_now: 2026 data is emphatic: 62% of small-business calls go unanswered and 85% of missed callers never call back; the virtual-receptionist market hit $4.64B in 2026 while voice AI agents grow at 34.8% CAGR toward $47.5B by 2034; a separate 1.4M-call analysis found avg missed-call cost ~$450. Healthcare adoption jumped to ~38% of practices (from ~12% in 2023).
items.monetization: Monthly subscriptions ($49-$569/mo typical; one vendor $147/mo + $0.25/min) versus $30K-$60K/yr for a human receptionist. A free calculator/web agent funnels into paid call volumes.

items.name: Chat-first personal AI assistant (web app)
items.summary: A free web tool where users text or type tasks (research, organise, shop/reserve, schedule) to a personal agent that does them end-to-end in the browser.
items.why_now: This is the single fastest-moving consumer category right now: Meta's Muse hit 5M downloads in 22 days (Fastest since ChatGPT), Instinct passed 100,000 users in 3 weeks and claims ~$1B annualized transaction volume, and OpenAI launched 'Dots' in October.
items.monetization: Subscription ($20/$100 per month at Muse; ChatGPT/Claude ~$20-100 tiers) moving toward transaction/affiliate fees as agents make purchases attributable to them.

items.name: Event invite, RSVP & date-poll page builder
items.summary: Free browser tool that turns a few clicks into a shareable invite page: RSVP, group chat, guest list, date polls and an optional paid-ticket link — the Partiful-style flow without requiring an app install, built as an original product.
items.why_now: Partiful's search volume is up 99x+ on Exploding Topics and it now draws roughly 30.2M monthly visits (+13.9% over 3 months per Systemaic's teardown); on 02 Jun 2026 it launched ticketing as its first-ever monetization, proving hosts will pay inside the invite flow while demand for a free, open alternative keeps rising.
items.monetization: Transaction fee on paid events (Partiful's own first revenue move), premium invite themes/designs, custom domains and promoted event placement.
items.how_searched: Looked up viral consumer event apps in Exploding Topics, opened an independent traffic teardown of Partiful, then read contemporaneous coverage of its ticketing launch to confirm monetization.

items.name: Personal data-broker opt-out & removal-request generator
items.summary: Free tool that shows where your name, address and phone appear across people-search/data-broker sites, generates the opt-out requests for you, and lets you track status; ongoing automated re-removal and breach monitoring sits behind a paid plan.
items.why_now: DeleteMe is estimated at ~$21.3M annual revenue (Growjo) while its Apr 16, 2026 TD SYNNEX partnership explicitly cites AI-driven PII harvesting as the new threat driver; a fresh WIRED hands-on review (Jun 27, 2026) documents mainstream demand and a $129/yr price point that a free self-serve generator can undercut.
items.monetization: Free one-time scan and self-serve request generation; paid annual subscription for continuous monitoring and automatic re-submissions (benchmark: DeleteMe $129/yr for one person).
items.how_searched: Searched data-removal service revenue and recent partnerships, opened a company-revenue estimate page, a news wire release and a dated consumer review to triangulate demand and pricing.

items.name: AI dubbing / video-localization web tool
items.summary: Auto-translate and dub a video into many languages while preserving the speaker's voice, with subtitles. A free creator-facing tool sits below enterprise OTT localization suites.
items.why_now: Adoption jumped in 2025-2026: ~58% of streaming platforms had deployed AI dubbing by June 2026 (from ~12% in 2022) and ~82% of YouTube creators over 100K subs now dub content; YouTube auto-dubbing expanded to 27 languages with 6M+ daily viewers. Markets: AI dubbing tools $1.35B in 2026 to $2.56B by 2030 (17.3% CAGR); AI dubbing for OTT $0.75B in 2026 to $2.45B by 2031 (26.71% CAGR); AI video localization $3.8B in 2025 to $21.2B by 2034 (19.4% CAGR).
items.monetization: Freemium minutes, per-minute credits, or creator subscriptions; incumbents charge per localized minute and enterprise licensing. Free watermark-free tier with paid minute packs is the classic wedge.

items.name: LLM / agent spend & cost observability dashboard
items.summary: A free web tool that ingests API logs and shows cost per user, per feature, per model, plus latency, caching and runaway-agent alerts.
items.why_now: 'AI Observability' search growth is ~9,300% (Exploding Topics), Braintrust raised at an $800M valuation, Langfuse was acquired by ClickHouse and Helicone by Mintlify in 2026, and Chargebee just open-sourced the AUDR standard for tracking agent run costs (top-3 Product Hunt launch).
items.monetization: Paid tiers run $29-$249/mo (Langfuse Core $29, LangSmith $39/seat, Braintrust Pro $249); caching/optimization claims save 20-30% on LLM bills.

items.name: TikTok Shop & winning-product trend finder
items.summary: A free dashboard that ranks products by live TikTok Shop GMV and search demand, flagging items with high searches but few videos (open lanes).
items.why_now: RapidTok's Sept 2026 report: the TikTok Shop USA top 10 made $23.2M in 30 days; TokConnect's Oct 2026 pull found 10 of 11 dupe searches had zero matching videos (1,490,773 searches/week unanswered); 'Fastmoss' search growth +6,600% in Exploding Topics' Oct 6, 2026 list.
items.monetization: Paid research subscriptions — competitors charge Kalodata from $45.99/mo, FastMoss from $49/mo, EchoTik up to $57/mo (prices checked Oct 5, 2026); TokConnect itself starts free then 50 free credits.
how_searched: vendor pricing pages (TokConnect comparison, checked Oct 5 2026)

items.name: GLP-1 price, coverage & provider comparison tool
items.summary: Free comparison site for GLP-1 medications: cash-pay prices across LillyDirect, NovoCare, GoodRx and telehealth providers, subscription-vs-direct cost calculator, insurance-coverage checker and dose cost explorer — pure information tooling, no medical services.
items.why_now: 'GLP 1 Supplement' searches are up 99x+ on Exploding Topics; Fact.MR sizes GLP-1 telehealth platforms at $763.8M in 2026 growing to $3,280M by 2036; and AInvest (Sep 12, 2026) reports ~19M Americans now on these drugs while prices collapse (GoodRx $39/mo, manufacturer-direct channels, 30+ FDA warning letters) — maximum consumer confusion right now.
items.monetization: Qualified lead-gen/affiliate fees from telehealth providers and pharmacies, display advertising, and premium price-drop/coverage alerts.
items.how_searched: Checked GLP-1-related breakout queries on Exploding Topics, opened the market-research size estimate, then read a dated 2026 analysis of provider pricing and channel shifts.

items.name: Cookie-consent / privacy-compliance generator
items.summary: Scan a site, detect trackers, generate a compliant cookie banner plus cookie/privacy policy, and block non-essential scripts before consent. A free generator for the long tail of small sites that big CMPs ignore.
items.why_now: Enforcement and penalties rose sharply in 2026: the UK's maximum PECR cookie fine jumped from £500K to £17.5M on 2026-02-05, and the ICO finalized equal-prominence "Reject All" guidance on 2026-04-29; the EDPB launched a 25-authority coordinated enforcement on transparency (March 2026). Industry audits still find ~35% of sites using pre-checked boxes, and the consent-management market grows from $1.2B in 2026 to $2.8B by 2033 (13.1% CAGR).
items.monetization: Freemium scan + paid hosted CMP subscription (incumbents charge roughly €29-€588/yr per domain, enterprise far higher); add-on policy generation, monitoring, and agency multi-site plans.

items.name: AI resume + job-application toolkit (ATS-tailored)
items.summary: A free web app that writes and tailors a resume to a pasted job description (keyword targeting/ATS pass-through) plus interview practice.
items.why_now: 'AI recruitment tools' search interest grew ~5,800% (explodingtitles), Rezi is pulling ~$257k-294k verified MRR with ~10,000 paying subs and ~1M new users/year, and Reactive Resume v6 launched on Product Hunt in the last week of October 2026.
items.monetization: Freemium to $29/mo plus $149 lifetime (Rezi); job seekers pay while hunting because the problem is urgent and time-boxed.

items.name: Prescription price-comparison & savings tool
items.summary: Search a drug plus ZIP to compare cash prices across discount programs and nearby pharmacies, with alerts on price changes. A free, no-insurance comparison tool.
items.why_now: Consumer interest is spiking: CompareMedsRx grew from ~10,000 to over 280,000 users in twelve months (April 2026) aggregating 20+ discount programs. GoodRx shows where the money is moving: Q2 2026 revenue was $200.4M from ~25M annual consumers, with subscriptions up 39% to $28.5M and Pharma Direct up 76% to $61.6M, even as legacy prescription-transaction revenue fell 26%.
items.monetization: Pharmacy/discount-program referral fees, manufacturer "consumer direct pricing" partnerships, and paid subscriptions (GoodRx Companion at $14.99/mo, or $9.99/mo annual).

items.name: AI agent memory manager
items.summary: A free, open web tool that captures what an AI coding agent did, compresses it, and replays the context into future sessions so agents remember across runs.
items.why_now: thedotmack/claude-mem has 97,798 stars (GitHub API, Oct 8, 2026), was pushed Oct 7, 2026, and appears on GitHub's trending list today; its site claude-mem.ai is live and describes cross-agent support (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, OpenCode and more).
items.monetization: Revenue not verified (null); open-source core with hosted/team add-ons is the plausible path — the star base (97.8K) is the distribution asset, and teams pay for managed memory.

items.name: AI-ready help center / llms.txt knowledge base
items.summary: A free static-site tool that generates an AI-readable knowledge base (llms.txt, markdown pages, MCP-ready) so a company's docs surface correctly in ChatGPT/Claude/Perplexity answers and agent crawlers can't be blocked by a bad robots.txt.
items.why_now: AI crawler compatibility is the most common GEO failure (blocked robots.txt), and 'docs for agents' products are launching weekly: Chat.sh (#8, Oct 1), DocsAlot MCP (#5) and Blume (#4) on Oct 4 2026, plus WikiFix for stale knowledge bases.
items.monetization: Chat.sh sells one-time $199/$599 lifetime, DocsAlot/Bracket pursue SaaS subscriptions; free generator monetizes via AI-citation/visibility audit upsell.

items.name: AI study & exam-practice platform
items.summary: A free web app that generates exam-style practice questions from any syllabus (or past papers) with instant feedback and adaptive review, plus an AI tutor.
items.why_now: Gauth topped Product Hunt's October list (468 points, 200M+ downloads since 2020), Coddy reports 5M+ learners, a niche CELPIP practice-site hit $1,101 MRR in 59 days, and 'a&p 1 study tips' surged +330% on TikTok in the first week of October 2026.
items.monetization: Freemium subscriptions/ads; Coddy is free-forever with premium, Gauth and niche exam-prep sites convert urgency (exam dates) into paid users.

items.name: Free no-signup, no-subscription web tools
items.summary: Single-purpose web tools that work instantly with no account, no subscription and (where possible) no server round-trip — the opposite of gated AI SaaS.
items.why_now: NoteWorthy ('on-device AI, no account, no subscription') hit #10 on Product Hunt's daily leaderboard for Oct 6, 2026 with a score of 109; independently, magicremover.org — 'free, no-signup image tool' — grew +4,374% MoM to 62.2K visits in the tracked AI-site sample.
items.monetization: Ad-supported or optional one-time pro unlocks; monetization per user is small — judged honestly as a traffic play first (upstream to paid products).
how_searched: traffic-growth analysis via dev.to (fastest-growing AI sites)

items.name: Online will / estate-document builder
items.summary: A guided web questionnaire that produces a jurisdiction-aware will and related documents (power of attorney, healthcare directive), optionally bundled with digital-asset inventory.
items.why_now: Structural demand keeps rising: online will/estate services grow from ~$0.97B in 2025 to $2.78B by 2034 (12.5% CAGR) with self-service at 54.3% share and LegalZoom alone estimated at $0.35-0.40B annual revenue; a separate estimate has it growing from $587.6M in 2026 to $1,364.77M by 2035 (9.3% CAGR). Drivers are remote online notarization laws, digital-asset succession, and a large intergenerational wealth transfer. (Market-size estimates vary widely by firm.)
items.monetization: Flat per-document ($100-$300 self-service), tiered managed review ($500-$1,200), or annual subscription for updates and bundled documents; fintech/advisor referral fees.

items.name: AI language conversation tutor
items.summary: A free web tool for spoken conversation practice with an AI partner: real-time dialogue, correction and pronunciation feedback in the learner's target language.
items.why_now: 'TalkPal' search growth is +6,600% in Exploding Topics' Oct 6, 2026 list (and 5-year +6,300% in its generative-AI startups list); revenue is proven — Speak made $100M in 2025 at a $1B valuation and Praktika.ai made $20M (GetLatka).
items.monetization: Freemium subscriptions: Speak's $100M/yr and Praktika's $20M/yr show learners pay $10-30/mo for conversation practice; free tier acquires, paid removes limits.
how_searched: search-trend tool (Exploding Topics Oct 2026 + startup list)

items.name: Free web microdrama platform (episodic short-drama player)
items.summary: Browser-based vertical short-drama experience: swipeable episodic series with coin/web-billing unlocks or ad-supported free episodes, a discovery feed, and original or AI-assisted series — rebuilding the format as a free website rather than cloning any catalog.
items.why_now: Media Partners Asia (report via Variety, Aug 6, 2026) sizes microdrama outside China at $3.6B in 2026 rising to $9.5B by 2031, with ReelShort alone at $1.05B (+34%); US app charts on Oct 7-8, 2026 show the format flooding top-free lists (PineDrama #12 iPhone, plus BlinkDrama, StoryReel, NetShort, DramaBox in the top 100).
items.monetization: Coin packs billed through our own web store (MPA notes margin upside from exactly this shift), ad-supported free episodes (MPA projects ads reaching ~15% of category revenue), and optional unlimited-pass subscriptions.
items.how_searched: Searched short-drama market revenue and reports, opened the Variety/MPA story, then verified live demand in two independent US app-store chart trackers updated Oct 7-8, 2026.

items.name: Viral-product dupe finder
items.summary: A free web tool where you paste a viral product or brand and get cheaper equivalent items that people are actively searching for instead.
items.why_now: TokConnect (Oct 2026): 10 of 11 dupe searches had no matching videos, together 1,490,773 searches/week unanswered; 'Dupe Of' has 22,200 monthly searches, up +236% in three months (Rising Trends); Circana (Aug 21, 2026) found 58% of shoppers have bought a dupe.
items.monetization: Affiliate/commerce revenue on referred cheaper alternatives; direct sales figures for such a tool were not found (null) — judged as demand-strong but monetization-unproven.

items.name: AI interior-design / room-redesign web tool
items.summary: Upload a photo of a room and get a redesigned rendering in a chosen style, with shoppable furniture suggestions. Mobile apps in this niche are already pulling six-figure monthly revenue.
items.why_now: Third-party trackers show large, monetizing audiences updating in the last weeks: Home AI (interior.home.design.ai) ~908K MAU / $10K+ per month est.; AI Home Design: Interior DecAI ~951K MAU / $50K+ per month est. and an independent estimate of ~$400K per month; AI Decor est. $120K-$660K per month with data updated 2026-10-07. The category keeps ship updates through September 2026.
items.monetization: In-app purchases/subscriptions (weekly/monthly plans) plus ads. Reported models mix IAP and ads (e.g., 63% IAP / 37% ads for one top app). Revenue figures are third-party estimates, not audited.

items.name: Free AI-text detector & authorship-proof checker
items.summary: No-signup paste-in tool that returns AI probability with sentence-level highlights, plus an optional 'writing replay' that logs keystrokes so users can prove human authorship; freemium with word-count limits and an API.
items.why_now: Superhuman (formerly Grammarly) acquired GPTZero on 23-24 Jun 2026 — 19M registered users and ~$30M ARR (TNW); Sacra independently estimates $24M ARR in 2025, +253% YoY. The category's biggest winner literally started as a free single-page web tool, and consolidation by incumbents leaves room for a fast free alternative.
items.monetization: Free tier with monthly word allowance, $15-24/mo paid tiers, API credits for publishers/recruiters, and education plans — pricing model documented in Sacra's breakdown.
items.how_searched: Searched AI-detector acquisition and revenue coverage, then opened both a news report and an independent revenue-research profile to confirm the numbers from two sources.

items.name: Cross-network competitor ad-library search (free tier)
items.summary: One search box across Meta, Google, TikTok, YouTube and LinkedIn ad-transparency libraries with saved swipe files and brand tracking; free tier runs on public transparency data, paid tier adds persistent archive, spend/run-length signals and a single API.
items.why_now: adlibrary.com reports 4,200+ paying users at €179/mo Pro (€29 entry) precisely because Meta's free library hides spend, drops paused ads and covers only 2 of 7 networks; a Sep 2026 MarketResearch.com report on the Digital Ad Intelligence Software market confirms the category is being re-priced right now.
items.monetization: Freemium subscriptions (€29-179/mo benchmark), API keys for data teams, multi-seat agency workspaces.
items.how_searched: Searched ad-library/AdSpy alternatives and pricing, opened the leading alternative's own pricing-and-coverage page, plus a current market-research report page for category sizing.

items.name: Promo-code finder & price-drop tracker
items.summary: Free web tool where you paste a product URL and get working promo codes (community-submitted plus store feeds), price history and drop alerts — a no-signup coupon/price tracker in the Honey mold, rebuilt as an independent site.
items.why_now: US free-app charts on Oct 7-8, 2026 show deal tools surging ahead of the holiday season: DealSeek at #7 on Android (up 28), Koupon and Capital One Shopping in the top 30 (Capital One Shopping brand-new to the chart), and Freecash at #5 on iPhone — seasonal demand is spiking right now.
items.monetization: Affiliate commissions on purchases (established cashback/affiliate rev-share model), merchant-funded placement of verified codes, premium price-drop alerts.
items.how_searched: Pulled current US top-free app charts from two independent chart trackers and looked specifically for coupon/deal/price-tracking apps and their rank movement.

items.name: Browser voice-dictation / hands-free writing tool
items.summary: A free on-device web tool that turns speech into formatted, cleaned-up text (removing filler words, auto-punctuating) for emails, prompts and chat apps.
items.why_now: AI voice/dictation keeps launching with real traction: Willow Voice (Product Hunt top-10 Oct 6, 'thousands of users daily, replacing up to 90% of typing'), Increible voice computer-control (top-5 Oct 6), and Plaud was #16 on consumer AI spending while voice players like ElevenLabs sit #10 in spend.
items.monetization: Subscription (Willow/Incredible subscription pricing); async voice revenue is red-hot across the a16z consumer-AI spend list.
